WALK-IN INTERVIEW FOR RECRUITMENT TO THE POST OF SENIOR RESIDENTS AND 
SPECIALIST ON CONTRACT BASIS
This is with reference to the recruitment notification/interview notice issued vide advertisement published
in newspaper Dainik Bhaskar (Hindi) dated 21/07/2026, Times of India on dated 22/07/2026 and details 
uploaded on official website.
A  walk-in interview  for filling  the vacant  posts of  Specialist,  Senior  Resident  (3 Years), and Senior  
Resident (1 Year) on a contract basis at ESIC Hospital, Gwalior, Madhya Pradesh
A  walk-in  interview  will  be  conducted  on  the  18/11/2026  (Reporting  Time:  09:00  AM  to  11:00  AM) and 
subsequently on 3rd Wednesday of every month . If the 3 rd Wednesday happens to be a gazetted holiday, the  
interview will instead be held on the immediately following Thursday or as notified from time to time. Notices  
regarding  such  vacancies  shall  be  published  only  on  the  ESIC  Headquarters’  official  website.  No  separate 
advertisements will be issued in newspapers. All updates related to the conduct of these interviews, including  
schedule  and  post-wise  requirements,  will  be  made  available  exclusively  on  the  official  website:  
www.esic.gov.in/recruitments  
The walk-in interview for the month of November 2026 will be conducted as per following schedule at  
ESIC Hospital, Tansen Nagar ,  Gwalior, on 18/11/2026 (Reporting Time:  09:00  AM  to  11:00  AM) for the

 Specialist(Full Time and Part Time) (Total posts-12)
 Senior Residents (3 Years) (Total posts-10)
 Senior Residents (1 Year) (Total posts-05)

following:
 Duly filled application in the prescribed format (Annexure ‘A’)
 Application fee (as applicable)

GENERAL INSTRUCTIONS TO CANDIDATES TO APPEAR IN WALK-IN-
INTERVIEW
1. The number of vacancies may be changed without any prior notice.
2. No. TA/DA will be admissible either for the ‘Walk-in-interview’ or for joining the post.
3. The Competent Authority reserves the right to fill up all or not to fill up any 
post or cancel any vacancy /interview at any stage.
4. The selected candidates will have to join stipulated date given in offer of appointment.
5. The selection is subject to the candidates providing their medical fitness 
Certificate issued by Medical Board at ESIC Hospital Gwalior.
6. Candidates  must be registered with Medical Council of India/NMC/State Medical 
Council before joining the post.
7. The candidate who is in the Service should submit “No Objection Certificate” from the 
employer at the time of interview.
8. The  selected  candidate  will  have  to  furnish  a  DD/Bankers  Cheque  for  an  amount  of 
Rs.10,000/-(Rupees Ten Thousand Only) drawn in favour of ‘ESIC fund 
A/cNo1’payable at Gwalior, towards security deposit.
9. Candidate seeking reservation benefits for SC/ST/OBC/EWS must ensure that they are  
entitled to such reservations per eligibility prescribed in the Notice. They should also 
be in possession of the required certificates in the prescribed format in support of their  
claim  as  stipulated  in  this  Notice.  OBC candidates  should  ensure  that  they  are  in 
possession of valid OBC Certificate issued with-in such issued by the authority 
mentioned in the format.
10. The candidate claiming reservation/age relaxation on grounds of belonging to OBC 
should submit the  Certificate in prescribe proforma vide Govt of India, Department of  
Personnel and Training OM No.36036/2/2013-Estt(Res) dated 30.05.2014 failing 
which the benefit of reservation / relaxation will not be given or their application shall 
be rejected and no request/correspondence will be entertained. Certificates issued in 
other format will not be accepted and the candidates will be treated as “General 
Category” for all purpose. Validity of OBC certificates issued by the Central 
Government is One Year from the date of issuance. So Candidate will not submit this  
Certificate One Year old .
11. Those who belong to SC/ST/OBC category should produce valid caste certificate 
issued by the Tahsildar/Revenue Divisional Officer. OBC certificate must be as 
prescribed vide DoPT, Govt of India OM No.36012/22/93-Estt.(SCT) dated 
15.11.1993 which should certify that the candidate do not belong to anyone of the 
Creamy Layers.
12. Candidates  claiming  reservation  under  EWS  category  should  produce  their  EWS  
certificate as prescribed vide DoPT, Govt of India OM No. 36039/1/2019-Estt.(Res) 
dated 31.01.2019.
13. The candidates are advised to  bring their application/Bio data and original certificates 
with one set of self attested photocopies of the certificates.
14. All the candidates are directed to report in the office of the Medical 
Superintendent ESIC Hospital, Gwalior, Madhya Pradesh as per the timing mentioned.
15. The decision of the selection board will be final on all aspects of selection and no 
further correspondence will be entertained under any circumstance.
16. The contractual appointment for part time contractual specialist will be for one 
year from the date of joining or appointment of regular incumbents whichever is 
earlier.
17. The candidates shall be governed by the relevant Rules and Regulations adopted by the  
ESIC in this regard.
18. Other terms & conditions will be applicable as issued by the Competent Authority from 
time to time.

General Terms and conditions for Service of Full Time/Part time Contractual 
Specialist and senor residents:-
1. Selected candidates will have no claim for regularization of the service in the hospital or  
No claim for any service benefit like PF, Pension, Gratuity, medical Allowance, Seniority,  
and Promotion.
2. Under  the  Specialist  category,  full-time  appointees  shall  be  given  priority  over  part-time 
appointees.
3. Hostel accommodation/quarters/uniform will not be provided.
4. The appointment shall not offer any right or preference for regular appointment.
5. In case regular incumbent joins in, the appointment shall be terminated immediately. The 
discretion will be solely of Medical Superintendent.
6. Available on call 24x7 if he/she is drawing/opted emergency call charges.
7. The Specialist shall be responsible for all cases undergoing treatment under his supervision in 
his discipline.
8. On selection candidates has to open an SB Account in the State Bank of India any Branches 
(This is applicable to cases where SB account is not held in State Bank of India).
9. The posts are contractual and the  contractual engagement may be terminated /  discontinued by 
either side giving one month prior notice to this effect without assigning any reason.
10. Submission of declaration of marital status and declaration of having only one living spouse in 
case of married individual and making a solemn affirmation to the effect of registration and 
taking an oath of allegiance/ faithfulness to the constitution of India.
11. In case of selection, the candidate has to  enter into an agreement with Medical Superintendent, 
ESIC Hospital, Gwalior, on Non-judicial stamp paper of Rs 1000/-. Upon joining, the selected  
candidate has to submit a security deposit of Rs. 10,000/-(Rupees Ten Thousand Only) as 
Demand draft in favour of ‘ESI Fund Account No.1’ payable at Gwalior which is refundable 
after successful completion of contract and production of ‘No dues certificate’.
SPECIAL TERMS AND CONDITIONS APPLICABLE TO FULL TIME 
CONTRACT SPECIALISTS:
1. Specialist shall be recruited for a period of 1 year and extendable up to 3 years with annual 
evaluation  and  term  renewed  every  year  based  on  satisfactory  performance.  Performance  will  be 
monitored by Competent Authority.
2. Private practice will not be allowed.
3. Available on call 24x7.
4. The specialist shall be responsible for all cases undergoing treatment under his supervision in his  
discipline.
5. He/She will be entitled for the leave @ 04 days for each month of work on pro-rata  basis in a  
calendar year. In the event, the specialist prefers not to avail the leave, the same may be encashed to 
a maximum limit of 30 days/year.
6. The selected specialist must have a professional indemnity policy which should cover the 
period as desired by ESIC. The policy is meant to cover professional liability falling on them as a 
result of errors and omissions committed by them while rendering professional services. The 
minimum sum assured per annum should be Rs.30 lakhs for  Anaesthesiologists, Cardiac Surgeon,  
Neuro  Surgeons,  Plastic  Surgeons  etc.  (2)  Rs.20  lakhs  for  General  Surgeons,  Gynaecologists,  and 
Obstetrician etc. (3) Rs.10 lakhs for Physicians Dentists, Radiologists and Pathologists etc. A copy 
of the Insurance & Premium receipt must be submitted within 7days from the date of engagement,  
otherwise service will be terminated.

SPECIAL TERMS AND CONDITIONS APPLICABLE TO PART –TIME CONTRACT 
SPECIALISTS:
1. Period of contract will be one year from the date of joining.
2. Minimum working hours will be 16 hours per week as per direction by Medical Superintendent, 
Gwalior.
3. He/She will not be entitled for any kind of leave or benefits.
4. Available on call 24x7ifhe/she is drawing/opted emergency call charges.
5. The specialist shall be responsible for all cases undergoing treatment under his 
supervision in his discipline.
6. The selected specialist must have a professional indemnity policy which should cover the period as  
desired by ESIC. The policy is meant to cover professional liability falling on them as a result of 
errors  and  omissions  committed  by  them  while  rendering  professional  services.  The  minimum  sum 
assured per annum should be Rs.30 lakhs for  Anaesthesiologists, Cardiac Surgeon, Neuro Surgeons,  
Plastic Surgeons etc. (2) Rs.20 lakhs for General Surgeons, Gynaecologists, and Obstetrician etc. (3)  
Rs.10  lakhs  for  Physicians  Dentists,  Radiologists  and  Pathologists  etc.  A  copy  of  the  Insurance  & 
Premium receipt must be submitted within 7days from the date of engagement, otherwise service will 
be terminated.
SPECIAL TERMS AND CONDITIONS APPLICABLE TO SENIOR RESIDENT
1. Selected candidates will have no claim for regularization of the service in the hospital or No 
claim for any service benefit like PF, Pension, Gratuity, medical Allowance, Seniority, and  
Promotion.
2. Senior residents (one year) on contractual basis will be recruiting as per requirement against 
sanction strength of GDMO lying vacant/unfiled post of regular SR. Senior residents (Three 
Years) on contractual basis  will be recruited  under central residency  scheme. However SR on 
contract will be engaged till regular GDMO join or contract period, whichever is earlier.
3. Private practice of any kind will not be allowed.
4. The senior residents so engaged will be required to sign a contact devised for the purpose on a stamp  
paper of Rs.1000/-. The original contract will remain in custody of hospital and its copy  will be  
handed over to the candidate.
5. Entitled to avail leave as per rule.
6. The Duties of the doctor will be as assigned by MS of the Hospital. They will be required to attend  
emergency duties as assigned by MS or his representative.
7. The  senior  residents  so  engaged shall  attend  to his/her  work  punctually.  He/She  will  not  absent 
himself/herself from said engagement without having obtained permission in writing from the Medical 
Superintendent of the hospital or from an Officer authorized by the Medical Superintendent to give  
such permission. However in case he/she meets with some accident or he/she becomes sick. He / She  
will be bound to send application for absence to the Medical Superintendent as early as possible  
informing the MS of the hospital about his/her illness and the  probable period up to which he/she will  
not be possible to attend the assigned work on account of accident / Sickness and application for such  
days/period shall be accompanied by medical certificate.
8. Absence from work for a period of fifteen days without proper permission of the competent authority  
will amount to voluntary abandonment of engagement and no further order of disengagement shall be  
necessary.
9. If the Doctor at any time be found guilty of any gross misconduct or negligence of his duties then the  
Medical  Superintendent  of  the  hospital  may  terminate  his/her  contractual  engagement  under  the 
contract without notice or payment in lieu of notice as is otherwise required.
10. No Hostel accommodation/quarters will be provided.
11. In case of joining of GDMO, the relieving of Senior Resident will be on ‘last come first go’ principle
Note: -  The vacancies have been prepared after all due diligence & care after implementation of  
Government of India reservation roster as per rules. If any discrepancy is noted at later stage, then it 
may be corrected/ rectified at the time of notice.

1. All  the  interested  candidates  are  requested  to  appear  for  the  document  verification  within  the  schedule

2. Only the candidates whose documents are verified and found eligible for  the post of  Senior

3. The Medical Superintendent, ESIC Hospital, Tansen Road, Gwalior reserves the right to vary these

4. Change  in  date  or  schedule  time  of  interview,  etc  if  any,  will  be  intimated  on  website

update/information relating to the recruitment. Other terms and conditions as mentioned above.
5. The Medical Superintendent, ESIC Hospital, Tansen Road, Gwalior will be  the controlling authority 
for full time/part time Contractual Specialist and Senior Residents.

2 passport size recent color photographs for appearing in interview with duly filled in 
application form in the prescribed format as per Annexure -A, without fail.

National e-Governance Division (NeGD) 
Digital India Corporation 
Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology Electronics Niketan  
   
Dated: 15.10.2026 
CIRCULAR 
Subject: Rolling Advertisement for filling up of various positions in National e-Governance Division (NeGD) on deputation basis 
 
NeGD invites applications for the following position on deputation basis at different level amongst officers holding regular positions at Central 
& State Government, PSUs, Autonomous organizations and Statutory bodies of Government of India, States & UT Go vernment. 
 
2. The National e -Governance Division (NeGD), under Digital India Corporation, a not -for-profit company of Ministry of Electronics & 
Information Technology (MeitY ), was set up to facilitate and support Programme Management of the Digital India Programme with a vision to 
transform India to a digitally empowered society and knowledge economy.

• Experience into  providing technical guidance on software

2. In respect of candidates presently placed at a higher

position in NeGD. 
A. Essential Qualifications  
Bachelor’s degree of a recognized University/Institute in a suitable 
discipline.  
B. Experience 
• Must have experience in administrative functions within a 
government department, PSU, or government-affiliated 
organization for administrative and policy matters. 
• Working knowledge of Govt. of India rules, CCS (Conduct) Rules, 
GFR (General Financial Rules), Delegation of Financial Powers 
Rules, and related instructions. 
• Prepare and process official correspondences, office orders, and 
circulars in accordance with prescribed formats and procedures. 
• Assist in preparation of budget estimates, expenditure 
monitoring, and administrative approvals. 
• Support contract management, vendor empanelment, and 
procurement in compliance with GFR and GeM guidelines. 
• Maintain confidentiality and ensure proper custody of office 
documents and files as per record management rules. 
C. Age Limit :  
The maximum age limit shall not exceed 56 years on the closing date 
of receipt of application. 
   
  
 
The envisioned roles and responsibilities of NeGD are as follows:  
 
1. Providing strategic direction in terms of framing policies and implementation strategy for the Digital India 
Programme in different domains of e -Governance 
2. Proactive support to Central and State Governments for Mission Mode Projects and other e -Governance 
projects 
3. Acting as a facilitator and catalyst for implementation of Digital India Program by various Ministries and State 
Governments 
4. Providing Technical Assistance – Offering expert support to Central Ministries and State Line Departments in 
their e-Governance initiatives, either independently or in collaboration with professional consultants.  
5. Conducting Technical Appraisals – Evaluating e-Governance projects to assess key aspects such as technology 
architecture, framework standards, security policies, service delivery mechanisms, and the integration of 
shared infrastructure to ensure scalabilit y and efficiency. 
6. Developing Standardized Documentation – Creating generic and model templates for Expressions of Interest 
(EoI), Requests for Proposals (RFPs), Standard Contracts, Public -Private Partnership (PPP) Models, and other 
essential documents to guide various proje ct stages and requirements across States.  
7. Enhancing Citizen Engagement – Ensuring effective communication with stakeholders through both offline 
channels and social media platforms to foster transparency, public participation, and feedback -driven 
improvements in government services.  
8. Assessing Impact and Readiness – Conducting impact assessments and e -Readiness evaluations of e -
Governance projects across all States and Union Territories (UTs) to measure effectiveness and identify areas 
for improvement. 
9. Capacity Building and Skill Development – Organizing training programs, workshops, and knowledge -sharing 
sessions for government officials and stakeholders to enhance their technical and managerial capabilities in 
e-Governance. 
10. Promoting Interoperability and Data Sharing – Facilitating seamless integration among various government 
systems by advocating for common standards, open APIs, and data -sharing frameworks to improve service 
delivery. 
11. Ensuring Cybersecurity and Data Protection – Establishing robust security policies, data protection measures, 
and compliance frameworks to safeguard citizen data and ensure secure digital transactions.  
12. Driving Innovation Through Emerging Technologies – Exploring and leveraging AI, blockchain, IoT, and cloud 
computing to enhance the efficiency, transparency, and security of e -Governance initiatives. 
13. Encouraging Public -Private Partnerships (PPPs) – Collaborating with private sector organizations, startups, 
and academia to drive innovation, improve service delivery, and ensure the sustainability of digital 
governance initiatives. 
14. Monitoring and Evaluation – Implementing real -time monitoring mechanisms, performance metrics, and 
feedback loops to track project progress, address challenges, and ensure continuous improvement.  
15. Supporting State-Specific Customization – Assisting States and UTs in tailoring digital -Governance solutions 
to address their unique administrative, cultural, and technological requirements.  
16. Encouraging Paperless Governance – Promoting electronic document management systems, digital 
signatures, and workflow automation to enhance efficiency and reduce administrative overhead.  
17. Aligning with Global Best Practices – Benchmarking India’s Digital -Governance initiatives against global 
standards and best practices to ensure competitiveness and continuous evolution.  
18. Recruitment, deployment and HR management of specialized resources in the State e -Governance Mission 
Teams in all States and UTs 
19. Development of competency frameworks, training guidelines, case studies, etc.  
20. Developing Online and Web based Training for IGOT in Mission Karmayogi.  
21. Knowledge management and sharing through workshops, development of case studies, sharing best 
practises and creation of knowledge repositories, etc  
For more details visit :  https://negd.gov.in/about-national-e-governance-division/#  
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
3. General Conditions: 
 
1. The initial period of deputation shall be for three years, extendable as per Government instructions subject to 
requirements of NeGD.  
 
2. Eligible candidates may send their applications in the prescribed proforma (Annexure I) through proper channel to the 
undersigned. Those who have applied earlier in response to this Department’s Circulars in this regard need to apply 
afresh. 
 
3. This is an open vacancy circular. Once sufficient number of applications from eligible candidates are received, the same 
shall be considered for interview / selection.  
 
4. Prescribed proforma of application form, eligibility conditions, Job Description and other details can be downloaded 
from the official website of MeitY, Digital India Corporation & NeGD viz. https://www.meity.gov.in/, 
https://dic.gov.in/ and https://negd.gov.in/. Selected candidates will be deployed on the post as per their grade pay 
and T&C of NeGD. 
 
5. Advance applications may be submitted directly by the candidates to meet the deadline. However, applications 
received without the proper channel, vigilance clearance/integrity certificate, and attested copies of APARs for the last 
five years must be comple ted and submitted through the proper channel at the time of the interview; otherwise, the 
application will not be considered, and no further correspondence will be entertained in this regard.  
 
6. The candidates must produce a No Objection Certificate (NOC) in the prescribed format at the time of the interview. 
Applications without a proper NOC will not be considered.  
 
4. Facilities available to officers of NeGD 
 
1. The officer/employee availing of medical facilities under the Central Government Health Scheme in the parent 
organization may opt to continue with the same. Further, Officer /Employee shall be eligible to avail of medical facilities 
as per the Medical Reimbursement Scheme of NeGD-DIC. 
2. Serving Government officers / staff joining NeGD shall be eligible for retention / allotment of General Pool Residential 
Accommodation (GPRA) under the Directorate of Estates during the period of their deputation in terms of the 
Ministry's Office Memorandum No. 5(1)/2024-GC dated 15.06.2026. 
3. The option of availing leased accommodation facilities shall be available subject to the preference of the officer.  
4. LTA on an annual basis, if opted in lieu of LTC.  
5. Allowance for IT equipment for official purposes as per level.
